Report_ID: Penta-3 (third pentavalent/DTP-containing dose) completion at 18 weeks of age
Title: Automated phone call and text reminders for childhood immunisations (PRIMM): a randomised controlled trial in Nigeria
Author: Ekhaguere OA, Oluwafemi RO, Badejoko B, Oyeneyin LO, Butali A, Lowenthal ED, Steenhoff AP
Comment: Table 2 lists Control in the first column and Intervention in the second; here group_1 is the Intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False) and group_2 the control arm. M_diff/effect_size_value is the paper's own reported risk difference (0.04, 95% CI -0.02 to 0.10), not a computed mean difference.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Intervention: automated voice call (English/Yoruba) + text message reminders plus standard care') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomised controlled trial (two-arm parallel, individually randomised)
Medium: automated voice call plus SMS text message

Author: Dissieka, Soohoo, Janmohamed, Doledec
Comment: P value reported only as "<0.001"; recorded as 0.001. Recruitment source: 29 public-sector health facilities in Korhogo district (rural, semi-urban, urban)

Author: Kazi AM, Ali M, Zubair K, Kalimuddin H, Kazi AN, Iqbal SP, Collet JP, Ali SA

Report_ID: Pentavalent3 (DTP3) coverage at 12 months of age
Title: Mobile phone-delivered reminders and incentives to improve childhood immunisation coverage and timeliness in Kenya (M-SIMU): a cluster randomised controlled trial
Author: Gibson DG, Ochieng B, Kagucia EW, Were J, Hayford K, Moulton LH, Levine OS, Odhiambo F, O'Brien KL, Feikin DR
Comment: Counts are from the modified-ITT analytic sample (children with MCH booklet data at 12 months: control 360 of 489 enrolled; SMS only 388 of 476 enrolled), not the full randomised denominators; enrolled-arm counts of pentavalent3 receipt are not reported. The reported RR (0.98, 0.96-1.01) is a cluster-adjusted GEE log-binomial estimate; raw event counts have been extracted for crude pooling per the plan.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('SMS only (SMS reminders 3 days and 1 day before scheduled pentavalent and measles visits, plus routine immunisation care)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Topic of Content: SMS immunisation reminders before scheduled pentavalent (6, 10, 14 weeks) and measles (9 months) visits
Participant type: Caregivers of infants aged 0-34 days and their infants in rural western Kenya (Gem and Asembo districts, KEMRI/CDC HDSS)
Recruitment source: Health and Demographic Surveillance System village reporters' birth notifications; household enrolment in 152 randomised villages
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of children who received pentavalent3 by 12 months of age, from written immunisation records on the MCH booklet
Outcome variable: Pentavalent3 (DTP3) coverage at 12 months of age
additional_group_ns: Arms excluded per synthesis plan (reminders combined with monetary incentives): SMS plus 75 KES n=446 analysed (439 [98%] received pentavalent3; RR 1.00, 0.98-1.02, p=0.82); SMS plus 200 KES n=406 analysed (401 [99%] received pentavalent3; RR 1.01, 0.99-1.02, p=0.58)
outcome_family: receipt of third dose of DTP-containing vaccine (DTP3/Penta-3)
effect_direction: slightly favours control (97% vs 98%, RR 0.98, non-significant)

Report_ID: Received third dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta3/DTP3) at 14 weeks
Title: Effectiveness of short message services reminder on childhood immunization programme in Kadoma, Zimbabwe - a randomized controlled trial, 2013
Author: Bangure et al.
Comment: Paper reports only percentages, not raw event counts. Events derived from the randomised arm denominators of 152 per arm as specified by the synthesis plan: 0.95 x 152 = 144.4 -> 144 (intervention); 0.75 x 152 = 114 (control). All 304 randomised participants were followed up at 14 weeks with no loss to follow-up, so these are ITT denominators. p-value recorded as the reported threshold p<0.001 (exact value not given). The paper's narrative states respondents receiving SMS were "1.3 times more likely" to have children immunized at 14 weeks and reports a risk difference of 16.3% (95% CI 12.5-28.0); these are not recorded as a named ratio effect measure because the paper gives no formal RR point estimate with CI, and the RD CI is not centred on its own point estimate (internal inconsistency). Outcome combines OPV3, Penta3 and PCV3 given at the same visit; Penta3 is not reported separately.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Intervention group: SMS reminders at 6, 10 and 14 weeks plus routine health education') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: Mothers/caregivers who delivered and were residents of Kadoma City, with a cell phone, and their infants
Recruitment source: Kadoma City clinics (Rimuka, Waverley, Chemukute) and Kadoma General Hospital, at delivery or 3rd/7th day post-delivery visits
Outcome measurement: Proportion of children immunized at 14 weeks (percentages reported; counts derived from arm denominators of 152)
Outcome variable: Received third dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta3/DTP3) at 14 weeks
outcome_family: receipt of third dose of DTP-containing vaccine (DTP3/Penta-3)
